messages:
devon: Quick follow-up from the cache-eviction postmortem. Need a one-page fast-triage + owners for remediation: runbook edits, pasteable commands, pre-deploy guard, and alert tuning. Claim items please.

jen_sre: I can take the runbook + CLI snippets (48h). Will make top-of-page '0-15m' play.

chris_platform: I'll own the admission webhook prototype and add /healthz?cache returning eviction_rate (target: 1 week).

maria_pm: I'll write QA gates and the short CS blurb for fallback routing (72h).

ian_product: I'll draft the customer note and prioritize rollout with CS/sales.

jen_sre: Example snippets to include at top: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n inference --since=20m | grep -i eviction`, `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --sort-by=.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount`, `redwood-ctl deployments list --since 2h`.

devon: Proposed escalation ladder: page oncall -> senior runtime (10m) -> runtime lead (30m) -> infra pager (60m). Open incident doc within 10m.

opsbot: Created ticket <https://tracker.redwood.local/RED-5102|RED-5102> "Fast-triage runbook + remediation owners" and monitor for eviction_rate > 0.005 over 10m.

devon: OK. Reconvene in 72h in this thread to close the runbook. Ping me or @chris_platform if blocked. Thanks everyone.
